title: ¡Rojito atascado en el barro! 🚒💦 | Canciones Infantiles #Shorts
world: muddy countryside road after rain (big brown puddle, wooden fence, rainbow sky) + toy car wash with rainbow brushes and bubbles
story: Rojito drives into a big mud puddle, SPLASH, mud flies (problem)
He is stuck: his wheels spin and spin, mud splatters (struggle)
He honks his bell, nobody hears, uy (try 1)
Idea! He sprays water from his roof hose on the mud (smart fix)
The mud melts away and he rolls out, yay (success)
He drives into the car wash: rainbow brushes and bubbles (wash)
He comes out shiny red and sparkling (reward)
He spots another mud puddle and grins (loop gag)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Splash! ¡Rojito en el barro!
[Verse]
Gira, gira, ¡no se mueve!
¡Tilín, tilín! ¿Quién me ayuda?
¡Agua, agua, chuf, chuf, chuf!
[Chorus]
¡Fuera barro, a rodar!
Burbujas de colores
¡Rojito, qué brillante!
[Outro]
¡Uy! ¿Otra vez?

shots: Extreme close-up at toy level: the little red fire truck character driving into a big brown mud puddle, a big splash of mud flying up around his surprised face with wide eyes.
He drives into the puddle and a big splash of mud flies up, his eyes go wide.
Medium shot on the muddy road: the little red fire truck character stuck in the brown mud puddle up to his wheels, his wheels spinning and splattering mud, a straining determined face.
His wheels spin fast in the mud, mud splatters, he strains but does not move.
Close-up: the little red fire truck character stuck in the mud, his golden bell ringing, looking left and right with a hopeful little face.
His golden bell rings and he looks left and right hopefully.
Medium shot on the muddy road: the little red fire truck character sprays a big arc of clear water from the small hose on his roof onto the mud puddle around him, a happy idea face.
Water sprays in a sparkling arc onto the mud, the mud starts to wash away.
Wide shot of the countryside road: the little red fire truck character rolls out of the puddle onto the dry road, happy, a little mud on his sides, the pale rainbow in the sky.
He rolls forward out of the puddle happily onto the road.
Medium shot in the toy car wash: the little red fire truck character between big spinning rainbow-colored brushes, covered in white soap foam and bubbles, giggling.
The rainbow brushes spin around him, foam and bubbles fly, he giggles.
Close-up in the car wash: the little red fire truck character perfectly clean and shiny red, sparkles twinkling on his paint, a big proud happy smile, a few bubbles floating.
Sparkles twinkle on his shiny paint and he smiles proudly.
Wide shot of the countryside road: the clean shiny little red fire truck character looks at another big mud puddle ahead with a mischievous grin.
He rolls slowly toward the puddle with a sneaky grin.
